name: Komachi-dori
about: A proposed layout for the user's approval before the level is built (docs/LEARNINGS.md A8): the photographic KM1-3_komachi_dori.png's ensemble, left to right, measured at about 120 px to the metre at its shop fronts and spread along the street in the order of its five lane pictures (KM1-3a to e, on the city prompts page), from Kamakura Station's east exit (x = -12, where every story level starts) to the shrine's side gate. Game axes: x along the street (m), z away from the camera (the play lane at z = 0), front: the z of a model's street face. Kit: the Kamakura kit (Art/Models/Kamakura); see-through boxes are what is still to come.
